m6lkey:315: The warning this incident delivers to the development tool ecosystem is fundamental. Most organizations do not know which extensions developers have specifically installed in VS Code, nor do they understand the permission scope of those extensions. The VS Code Marketplace lacks a fine-grained permission review mechanism; extensions can request access to the network, filesystem, environment variables, and even the terminal—combined, these permissions amount to a persistent, advanced backdoor. More critically, credentials in CI/CD pipelines (PyPI tokens, AWS credentials, Docker registry keys) typically exist as environment variables; once an attacker gains access to a developer's workstation through an IDE extension, those credentials are exposed as well. durabletask's 417,000 monthly downloads mean that any machine was already compromised the moment it installed the affected version.
